response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 2","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Maybe it would have been better if Hadassah had stood up to them, but she didn’t.","suggested_fix":"Replace the phrase “kuwakananisha” with a more natural Kiswahili verb for ‘stand up to’ such as “kuwapinga” or “kumkabili” to preserve the intended meaning and idiom.","translation_quote":"Labda ingekuwa bora kama Hadassah angehimili na kuwakananisha, lakini hakufanya hivyo."},{"location":"First figure img alt","severity":"minor","source_quote":"An empty classroom with rows of desks","suggested_fix":"Use a natural Kiswahili phrase for “rows of desks,” for example “darasa tupu lenye safu za davi/dawati” or “darasa tupu lenye safu za madawati.” Replace “mizunguko ya dawati” with one of those.","translation_quote":"Darasa tupu lenye mizunguko ya dawati"},{"location":"Fourth figure img alt","severity":"minor","source_quote":"An ambulance driving with its emergency lights on","suggested_fix":"Use the consistent and more accurate Kiswahili term “gari la dharura” rather than “gari la wagonjwa.” For example: “Gari la dharura likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zinawaka.”","translation_quote":"Gari la wagonjwa likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zinawaka"}],"passed":false,"score":94}
